name: InstaPods
line: Run persistent Linux app containers with SSH and built-in proxying.

free.text: One-time $10 starter credit; no ongoing free plan

work.math: $3 for a full-month plan, which includes 100 GB of traffic and 100 build minutes. 100 MB of files fits within 10 GB before code and dependencies. Whether builds fit is untested.
A plan with 2 vCPU, 2 GB and 25 GB. A full month costs $7, with requests, bandwidth and builds included. The exact 730-hour charge depends on calendar dates.
A plan with 2 vCPU, 4 GB and 50 GB includes local PostgreSQL and daily backups, up to 10 saved copies. Seven-day coverage with successful backups is not guaranteed.
